scope: Analytic counterexamples only; no competition samples, no model training, no GPU.

linear_unbiased_not_db_unbiased.assumptions: Positive unmasked unclipped power. Selection by validity masks or clipping adds further changes.

power_not_complex_field.meaning: Equal scalar power can coexist with different phase gradients and surface Helmholtz ratios. Not a measurement of dataset ambiguity.

multiple_TX_do_not_identify_free_interna.scope: A,K,Q all free. Known physical A,Q, units and coupling can remove this freedom. Not a proof of unidentifiability for the competition.

fixed_transport_residual_bound.scope: Known correct K,Q and operator norm strictly below one; it does not validate geometry or labels.

squared_MC_residual_bias.scope: Constructed scalar example. A noisy unbiased operator estimate need not yield an unbiased squared residual objective. Not a finding about the released dataset or a reproduction of Neural Radiosity.

C138_limitations: Transport kernel is fixed physics in this pilot; K is not learned.
Only one diffuse event in an enumerated path; not the complete repeated diffuse transport proposal.
Specular launch factors and learned aggregated diffuse-state factors are separate; learned initial-light changes are not propagated consistently into diffuse-prefix sources.
Original four retained FIT TX used, not all51.
Source quadrature8 retains numerical error, quantified by C135 refinements.
Native propagation has not passed the500ms end-to-end inference gate.
Positive source-state calibration is not a proof of passivity or global energy conservation; the complete coupled passive learned K remains unimplemented.
verified_local_evidence.scope: C138=16 fixed FIT maps, sampled points. C139=128 terrain monitor sampled points. Neither is official validation.
